itemDispositions.reasoning: Opened scripts/harness/control-field-validation.ts:68-96 and scripts/harness/generate-harness-controls.ts:171-174,214-250. pairedGuide is validated as a nonblank, existing in-repository path, and the generated control inventory publishes the forward control-to-guide link. A reciprocal guide declaration would create a second relationship registry without establishing a missing correctness condition; reverse provenance/queryability is already the subject of leaf 220.

Opened scripts/ai-hooks/session-state.sh:5-11,94-152 and scripts/ai-hooks/stop-policy.sh:381-445,571-662. Session-state deliberately reuses stop-policy's low-level readers, but its summaries implement different policy: they ignore Stop kill switches and notification counters, and cached verify reports do not perform Stop's fingerprint-currentness test. The similar formatting fronts different decisions, so a shared shell codec would add coupling without removing a material defect.

Opened both standalone sensor reuse paths. Near-duplicate reuse does not rewrite diagnostics, so the cut's plural claim is too broad. The Knip path is concrete: scripts/drift-ai/knip-runner.ts:176-203 exports a reusable runner but embeds the drift:ai label, while scripts/sensor-knip-unused-exports-core.ts:234-268 wraps its callback solely to regex-replace that prefix.

Opened scripts/max-lines-exceptions-core.ts:31-76 and tools/lint-ratchet/src/kernel/entry-baseline.ts:24-44. The aliases form an explicit adapter: the generic gate requires key/count, while the committed JSON contract uses path/cap, and makeMaxLinesExceptionEntry constructs both pairs together. No production path mutates them independently, so changing the shared baseline kernel to remove this localized bridge is disproportionate.

Opened scripts/code-intel/server-cli.ts. ServerCliCommand includes start at line 31, but parseServerCliCommand only returns status, stop, or restart at lines 97-105. The dispatcher handles status and stop explicitly and sends the only remaining reachable command to restartCommand at lines 89-94, making start unconstructable.

Opened drift-ai.config.json, scripts/drift-ai/config.ts, config-readers.ts, ghost-files-current.ts, and the operator guide. Eight current-scope suppressions are bare path pairs at drift-ai.config.json:15-29; the runtime model and parser have no rationale field, even though README.md:344-350 describes them as explicit exceptions for heuristic residuals.

Opened triage-packet-group.ts, triage-packet-types.ts, and triage-packets.ts. Normal packing flushes before exceeding packetSize, and oversized connected components are divided into balanced chunks. toGroup nevertheless computes items.length > packetSize, so oversized is always false and is then serialized into both packet and manifest shapes.

Opened coldspots-aggregate.ts, coldspots-coldspot.ts, and hotspots-history.ts. FileAggregate writes added and oldestTouchMs, but the reducer reads newestTouchMs for age and revisions, churnLines, and birth fields for qualification/output. added is write-only, and oldestTouchMs is maintained only because the shared helper mutates both bounds.

Opened both backfills. backfill-srd-spell-combat.ts constructs exactSrdIds from rows at lines 31-38, then derives each checked id from the same current row. backfill-srd-monster-actions.ts repeats the tautology at lines 42-48. These checks resemble trusted-corpus scope protection but cannot reject any supplied row.

Opened packages/server/prisma/schema.prisma throughout. It is 1,479 lines but deliberately sectioned into enums, SRD, character, campaign, combat, VTT, and homebrew domains, with cross-domain relations visible in one catalog. The title establishes size rather than drift or mistaken ownership; a multi-file split would add navigation and movement cost without a demonstrated defect.

Opened the two production HTTP authentication boundaries. trpc/context.ts:14-20 privately defines Bearer parsing, while routes/upload-routes.ts:49,65-68 repeats the prefix check, slice, and token verification. The REST route's distinct error mapping is intentional, but authorization-header interpretation is not boundary-specific.

Opened packages/server/prisma/seed.ts:8-32 and seed-template.ts:10-33. They duplicate logger setup, DATABASE_URL validation, adapter/client construction, main/catch/finally wiring, and failure reporting. Both call process.exit(1) before their chained finally claims to disconnect, duplicating a fragile forced-exit lifecycle.

Opened death-saves.tsx:37-60, desktop-sheet-layout.tsx:81-89, mobile-sheet-tabs.tsx:87-95, and character-sheet.test.tsx:12,122-134. Production renders DeathSavesInteractive on both layouts; the legacy DeathSaves component has no production consumer and survives only because a broad test imports it directly.

Opened the spell picker, row, detail, cast, VTT tab, and cast-rail presentations. They are density- and context-specific: compact surfaces use C/R glyphs, detail/cast use full badges, VTT adds aria labels and test hooks, and the rail composes prose metadata. Only two boolean guards repeat; a shared component would require variants that obscure the local markup.

Opened tool-handlers.ts:50-87,207-225 and map-canvas-store.ts:443-452. One handler routes freehand, line, rectangle, and circle moves through updateDrawing, which always copies and appends freehandPoints. Only the freehand builder reads that history; the other builders use startPoint/currentPoint.

Opened tool-handlers.ts:146-149,301-318 and use-canvas-input.ts:57-120,139-145. The handlers array is needed locally to populate handlerMap but is unnecessarily returned and unread. The residual is one private interface field and one shorthand property; removing it changes no live branching, work, or meaningful maintenance risk. Leaf 047 owns the material registry design issue.

Opened use-campaign-presence.ts:26-126 and campaign-room-handler.ts:23-57. Event/state handlers are already extracted. The effect owns one external lease lifecycle: join/rejoin, matched listener registration/removal, heartbeat start/clear, and StrictMode-aware leave defer/cancel. Server handling confirms heartbeat revalidates membership, so splitting the lifecycle would add cleanup coordination without addressing a defect.

Opened dice.ts, chat-inputs.ts, dice-inputs.ts, use-ability-roll.ts, and use-weapon-roll.ts. dice.roll exposes generic chatMessageSchema metadata even though the producer always writes RollResult. The hooks reconstruct that procedure-specific contract through four unchecked assertions; one boundary comment falsely claims tRPC already guarantees RollResult.

Opened roll-toast.ts:64-105 and roll-toast.test.ts:120-140. The createElement code is a bounded two-level toast body plus the required toast.custom render wrapper. Presentation is isolated from formatting and crit logic, and rendered badges are covered. Renaming the file to TSX would be readability-only churn.

Opened use-long-press.ts:35-38,128-135, roll-context-menu.tsx:139-142, and the keyboard-path test at use-long-press.test.ts:255-270. elementCenter returns and tests rect.left/rect.bottom, which the menu uses directly as its CSS anchor. The behavior is intentional; the helper name is false.

Opened the contrasting character-sheet hooks and their consumers. Some recreate wrappers and others expose or memoize mutation adapters, but the unstable callbacks feed ordinary non-memoized components, with LevelUpDialogSlot unmounted while closed. No effect, subscription, or memoized boundary relies on identity, so standardizing every hook would add callback machinery without demonstrated benefit.

Opened create-map-dialog.tsx:203-253, maps-panel.tsx:157-168, and use-map-image-preview.ts:48-53. The always-mounted dialog resets its draft only through handleClose, but successful creation closes it from the parent with setCreateOpen(false), bypassing that reset. Reopening can retain the submitted draft/file/preview, and the object URL cleanup does not run because the hook owner remains mounted.

Opened encounter-participants.tsx:123-203, shared encounter summary fields, and realtime-invalidation.ts:87-125. Most affected mutations change list-summary fields, and every server mutation emits the coarse encounter:updated event whose handler already invalidates detail, list, and logs. Narrowing only local callbacks would not remove refetches; richer socket semantics would be an unmeasured optimization. Leaf 043 already owns controller relocation while preserving behavior.

Opened add-participant-dialog.tsx:115-131, combat-log-panel.tsx:178-223, and ui/select.tsx. The three native selects are not duplicate form controls: challenge rating is a full-width labeled field, while action and participant are compact inline log controls with different option models. Replacing them with the portal-based Radix primitive changes interaction behavior without removing meaningful duplication.

Opened homebrew-page.tsx:94-228 and collection-detail-page.tsx:81-259. Their state machines diverge: the collection page owns import and one search query, while detail owns collection plus entry queries, a type filter, and collection-scoped dialogs. Both already isolate their distinct query-state rendering. At two consumers, a generic CRUD-page controller would add a polymorphic boundary; leaf 239 owns the genuinely identical deletion-dialog shell.

Opened all four production useParams({ strict: false }) sites and their route declarations. Each path requires its parameter, yet each page opts out of route-specific inference and compensates with empty-string fallbacks, disabled queries, or unreachable missing-ID UI. CampaignDetailPage demonstrates the intended route-specific useSearch/useNavigate form beside its widened useParams call.

promotionCandidates.title: Make Knip runner diagnostics caller-neutral

evidence.note: The exported runner accepts a generic warning callback but hard-codes drift:ai into both heartbeat messages.
The standalone sensor wraps the callback with an anchored replacement from drift:ai to sensor:knip-unused-exports.
The header still describes the runner as owned solely by the orphan-files adapter.

promotionCandidates.problem: A reusable subprocess boundary owns one caller's diagnostic identity, forcing another production caller to parse and rewrite human-facing text. Message changes can leak the wrong command identity or silently break the replacement.
promotionCandidates.proposedDirection: Emit caller-neutral heartbeat text or typed heartbeat events and let each caller add its command label. Remove the sensor's prefix rewrite and refresh the stale header.

origins.originalTitle: Reusable sensor engines live beneath drift-ai and rewrite its diagnostic identity.

priorPackOverlaps.residual: The scheduled sensor-family move does not address the imported runner's hard-coded label or the sensor's text rewrite.
No drift-ai directory restructuring is proposed; this residual is caller-neutral formatting at the existing boundary.

promotionCandidates.title: Rename elementCenter to match its intentional bottom-left menu anchor

promotionCandidates.title: CreateMapDialog retains its submitted draft because successful close bypasses reset

evidence.note: The persistently mounted component owns form, image-mode, upload, file, and preview state.
State resets only through handleClose.
Success closes from the parent with setCreateOpen(false), bypassing handleClose.
Object URLs are revoked on hook-owner unmount, which a controlled close does not cause.

promotionCandidates.problem: Successful creation bypasses the dialog's manual reset, so reopening can expose the submitted name, dimensions, image mode/file, and preview. The selected-file object URL also remains live while the always-mounted owner survives.
promotionCandidates.proposedDirection: Place draft/upload/preview state in keyed dialog content so every close/reopen transition remounts and cleanup runs; add a close-after-success and reopen regression case.

coverageNotes: Audited exactly the 26 assigned cut items across lanes 01, 02, 03, and 05; no files were modified and no tests or builds were run.

Every cited source path was opened against the tree identical to AUDIT_TARGET_SHA; authored leaf titles, the distilled prior-pack corpus, live prior constraints, and originating wave context were reviewed.

For lane-01 cut[17], both standalone sensor reuse paths were inspected; the promotion is intentionally narrowed to the Knip runner because near-duplicate reuse did not substantiate diagnostic rewriting.
For lane-05 cut[27], the survey covered the production character-sheet hooks and their sheet-layout/dialog consumers; no identity-sensitive effect, subscription, or memoized boundary was found.

The CreateMapDialog candidate explicitly addresses the only potentially broad reading of CQ25-216; the freehand and dice candidates leave the persisted/store shapes protected by CQ25-188 and CQ25-179 unchanged.
